en.evening-wind-down.title: Evening wind-down
en.evening-wind-down.description: From putting your phone on its charger to a short, calm routine that ends your day at about the same time each night.
en.evening-wind-down.why: Why do you want your evenings to end more calmly? In your own words.
en.evening-wind-down.anchor: brushing my teeth in the evening
en.evening-wind-down.build.v2: A log over the quiet water
en.evening-wind-down.build.v3: A plank bridge into the evening
en.evening-wind-down.build.v5: A covered bridge for the night
en.evening-wind-down.charger.action: put my phone on its charger for the night
en.evening-wind-down.charger.arrival: It starts small: your phone gets its place for the night, and the first piece is laid.
en.evening-wind-down.charger.accept: The charger is part of your evening now. You could add two calm minutes after it.
en.evening-wind-down.charger.nugget: You could give the charger a fixed spot out of reach of your bed, and put a book or a notepad where the phone used to lie.
en.evening-wind-down.calm-2.action: do one calm thing for two minutes, with my phone on its charger
en.evening-wind-down.calm-2.arrival: The first piece holds. The evening gets a little quieter around it.
en.evening-wind-down.calm-2.accept: Two minutes became easy. You could give your calm thing a little more room.
en.evening-wind-down.calm-2.nugget: The calm thing is yours to choose: a few pages of a book, a stretch, or writing down what is on your list for tomorrow, so it can wait there.
en.evening-wind-down.calm-10.action: give ten minutes to my calm thing, with my phone on its charger
en.evening-wind-down.calm-10.arrival: What you started keeps growing, a few quiet minutes at a time.
en.evening-wind-down.calm-10.accept: Ten quiet minutes have their place now. You could let them end at about the same time each night.
en.evening-wind-down.calm-10.nugget: You could plan for a late night now: "If it gets late, then I will only put my phone on its charger." The smaller step still counts.
en.evening-wind-down.lights-out.action: turn the light out at about my chosen time, after the charger and ten calm minutes
en.evening-wind-down.lights-out.arrival: One more piece: an evening that ends at about the same time.
en.evening-wind-down.lights-out.accept: Your evening has a shape now.
en.evening-wind-down.lights-out.nugget: You could set a quiet alarm for the time you want to start brushing your teeth. A late evening now and then is part of life and changes nothing.
en.evening-wind-down.ending: Your day ends by itself now: the phone on its charger, ten calm minutes and the light out at about the same time.
